title: Мангилик Ел × Улы Дала
scope: straight-through controlled experiment with 100 civilian vehicles and one ambulance
limitations: The corridor cutout preserves source lane attributes and movements but has artificial outer boundaries.
SUMO traffic-light phases are model phases, not confirmed controller timings from Astana.
The current lane inventory comes from the project OSM snapshot and requires manual field or official-scheme review.
Traffic demand is synthetic and must not be described as measured Astana traffic volume.
